$schema.description: URL of this schema, so editors can validate the file.

addr.description: Address to listen on, as host:port. Defaults to 127.0.0.1:7878.

idle_timeout.description: Close a session with no clients and no work after this long, as a Go duration. Defaults to 5m.

open_timeout.description: Give up opening a session after this long, as a Go duration. Defaults to 10s.

heartbeat.description: Send a heartbeat on an idle event stream this often, as a Go duration. Defaults to 20s.

listen.description: Where the server listens and how it times out clients.

protocol.description: Wire protocol. Empty uses the provider's default.

model.description: Model name. Required for openrouter; for anthropic, empty uses the built-in default.

api_key.description: Where to read the provider's API key: an op:// 1Password reference or env:NAME. Never the key itself. Empty uses the provider's default credentials.

provider.description: The model provider for new sessions. Existing sessions keep their pin.

author.description: The git user.name and user.email for commits in new sandboxed sessions, as NAME <EMAIL>.

hosts.description: Git hosts by kind. A host with a token lets sandboxed sessions clone and push to it.

token.description: Where to read the token: an op:// 1Password reference, gh for the GitHub CLI's token, or env:NAME. Never the token itself.

environments.description: Sandbox environments, by name. A session picks one; default is used when it names none.

image.description: The worker image sessions in this environment run.

grants.description: Network grants for sessions in this environment.

approvals.description: Whether tool calls in sandboxed sessions of this environment ask for approval: ask (default) or auto. With auto calls run without approval; hooks still apply.

title: durable-server config
description: Settings for durable-server, read from ~/.durable/config.json. Command line flags override them.
